acceptanceCriteria: A single commit with more than 256 hunks, each cited, binds and passes dogfood-check without restructuring history, or docs/DOGFOOD.md documents staged binding as the supported route with the exact steps.
Any new bound is stated in the refusal fix text and covered by a test at the bound and one past it.
No hunk becomes uncited or cited implicitly: the CEM still reports supported=hunks, unknown=0.
body: Observed 2026-10-10 (corvint-tasks build 407, origin/main 556fef97) on the store test-speed lane (PR beamfall/corvint#735). The change was one test-only commit with 279 hunks, mostly one-line t.Parallel() insertions across 51 files. Pass 2 of `make dogfood-change` refused `cem-cite: invalid-citation-plan` with fix text 'at most 256 rows' (internal/dogfoodflow/change.go:1005); the same 256-row bound applies to DOGFOOD_OCM_LINKS (change.go:1018). Expected: a large, mechanically uniform change can be bound in one pass with every hunk still individually cited. Actual: the only route was rebuilding the branch as two commits with byte-identical final tree and binding each in a fresh clone (two bind and two seal commits). Workaround cost roughly one extra agent cycle. Options to decide: raise the bound with a measured limit, allow one row to cite a hunk range for the same path and evidence, or document staged binding as the supported route in docs/DOGFOOD.md.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#762 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/762; landed by batch PR #789); on main at 00dd220753973cd7eb332b3b7572db4a2ca60265 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/789). Tests named in the PR: real-binary 279-hunk staged-binding test. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). title: dogfood-change: the 256-row citation plan cap forces large mechanical commits to be split and bound in stages
